correctness.rationale: The characteristic factor was reconstructed from the source. Under 0<h<b/3 its frequency polynomial has negative constant term, hence exactly one positive frequency-square root. The phase equations give all delays by adding 2π, the sine sign is proved positive in both a≥h and a<h cases, and D(0,τ) never vanishes. At every phase repetition the source's transversality criterion has the same strictly positive value because 2ω_H^2+κ=sqrt(κ^2-4ζ). Starting from the source's stable τ=0 case, standard retarded spectral continuity therefore gives the exact root-count ladder and excludes restabilization.

value.rationale: The motivating paper leaves the all-delay stability picture open after establishing a first Hopf loss and only an eventual-instability statement. The exact classification determines whether increasing biological maturation delay can ever restore the desirable rat-free equilibrium and quantifies how many unstable modes accumulate. This is a natural complete classification of the model's delay-dependent local stability rather than a parameter renaming or a routine numerical increment.
